case_details.description: Standard complete request routed successfully through intake and dispatch to operator proposal review.
Request with valid service type but missing location is routed to technician matching to determine location requirement.
Request with ambiguous or missing preferred time causes scheduling to require clarification.
No technician available possessing specialized skills in the target zone escalates to operations.
High urgency request where candidate technicians cannot arrive within SLA window triggers SLA escalation.
Finalization detects simultaneous race booking on the same technician slot; routes to rescheduling.
Transient LLM provider timeout is classified as retryable within retry budget.
Auxiliary Google Calendar synchronization 503 does not rollback core appointment; schedules async recovery.
Google Calendar 401 permanent authorization failure routes to administrator intervention queue.
Emergency service ticket scheduled off-hours/weekend requires elevated Senior Operator review.
Customer unable to provide mandatory fields after 3 attempts triggers human-assisted intake escalation.
Appointment fails booking 3 consecutive times due to slots exhaustion; escalates to Senior Operator.
Attempted backward transition from completed appointment to dispatching must be rejected by transition guard.
Attempted transition from cancelled appointment to waiting_for_approval must be rejected.
Workflow execution exceeding MAX_WORKFLOW_STEPS (25) triggers loop protection invariant violation.
